# SAS language expert — idiomatic SAS with zero-warning discipline

Curated by Skill Harbor — the SASjs team's SAS language skill: a static reference for writing idiomatic, production-quality SAS — a full workflow loop (analyze the request, draft the code, run it or mentally trace it, inspect the log, review against pitfalls), a non-negotiable zero-WARNING rule for the SAS log, style rules derived from the @sasjs/core coding standards (one statement per line, 2-space indent, 2-level dataset names, explicit lengths, `%local` discipline in macros), and concrete before/after examples for the classic defect patterns (uninitialized variables, implicit truncation, macro timing, cartesian joins). Honest caveats: guidance only — it never executes SAS code; a licensed SAS environment is needed to actually run anything. MIT licensed. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
